back.es: to agree (on), to decide jointly, to settle on (transitive verb)
back.example: We agreed to see each other at eight.

note: The hint separates this card from "estar de acuerdo" (to share an opinion) and from the reflexive "acordarse de" card; people also say "quedar en" for this in casual speech, but the prompt asks for a single verb, so acordar is the clear answer.
